Detailed Description

Used to explicitly enable or disable contact between links in a bot.

By default, all bots will spawn with contact disabled between links and their first ancestor with a physics body not connected via a Hard joint. This structure can be used to either reenable contact on those pairs, or disable contact between links that are not strictly child-parent. Overrides are applied on bot link actors after spawn using Scene::EnableActorContactSymmetric.

See also
BotPrefab::contactOverrides, Scene::EnableActorContactSymmetric
